summary: The v43 self-contained bundle restores the approved architecture-v28 mainline: pure T-known market-state mechanics, append-only ledger reconciliation preserving the M6 6/44 prefix, read-only static M6 archive verification, one trusted single-process 2x7 CUDA archival replay writing one receipt in a previously absent directory, and bounded M7 CCC/Gate semantics and tests. Privileged, multi-process, sandbox, capacity and live-authority designs are retained only as non-normative historical or deferred production hardening. This registers design evidence only and authorizes no test execution, implementation, replay, fitting, real-data access, PIT rerun, budget mutation or final-OOS access.
